answer.book: Hieronymi Zanchii De sacra scriptura tractatus integer (Neustadt, 1598): one volume of several works, a dedication and preface, an inaugural oration, a commonplace preface, the locus De sacra scriptura in twelve quaestiones with chapters, and two earlier Heidelberg disputations (1569, 1570) with their prefaces, appended after the locus.
